metadata.title: Urban Hip-Hop Portrait with Geometric Overlays

retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle urban portrait featuring a central subject framed by architectural curves and layered with vertical block typography and thin geometric wireframe accents.
excludeWhen: minimalist white space is needed without overlays

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-angle portrait of a male figure in urban attire, positioned centrally against a bright sky and a curved architectural structure. The left side is dominated by a dark vertical band containing large, distressed block typography, while the bottom left features thin, orange geometric line art.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a bright, high-key background
Vertical text bar balancing the visual weight of the subject
Curved architectural lines echoing the subject's posture
Geometric wireframes providing a technical contrast to the organic portrait
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows on the subject's torso
A mix of thick blocky elements and thin linear graphics

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-close shot from waist up, filling the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large vertical text on the left margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the torso to the geometric lines, then up the vertical text bar on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white space in the upper right and background, providing breathing room for the dense left-side graphics.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy/black for shadows and the vertical sidebar.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the sky and architectural highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange for the thin geometric wireframe lines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject/sidebar and the background; low saturation except for the orange accents.

letterConstructionRules: Distressed or 'eroded' edges on the main display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sliced or fragmented horizontally
Stems are thickened to create a block-like appearance
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy distressed display type paired with clean, small-scale technical monospace.
graphicDevices: Vertical dark color block on the left
Thin orange wireframe triangles in the bottom left corner
Rounded white shape overlapping the bottom of the vertical bar

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the display text.
Matches the technical, secondary metadata feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle portrait of a man in a dark vest and cargo pants, standing against a bright white sky with a large concrete archway in the background. Apply high contrast and deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a dark navy vertical bar on the left edge. Place large, distressed, white vertically-oriented block text inside the bar. Add thin orange geometric wireframe lines in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise?
Is the lighting high-contrast with a bright background?
Are the orange geometric lines thin and precise?
Is the subject viewed from a low angle?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Any specific tattoos or jewelry designs

mustAchieve: Clean separation between subject and graphic overlays
avoid: Illegible text due to low contrast

postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical text alignment and rotation.
Ensure the orange wireframe does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the high-contrast lighting on the torso.
Confirm the presence of the architectural arch in the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [low-angle urban portrait] with a [vertical sidebar containing distressed block type] and [thin geometric wireframe accents] using a [high-contrast, high-key] lighting scheme.
